title: Set skeleton, deterministic ids and gzip; tempo, time signature and loop brace
description:
## Intent

The set document: skeleton, ids, gzip, deterministic bytes.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/set.rs`: load the skeleton captured in M0 (`crates/apricity-daw/templates/set.xml`, derived from the reference `empty.als`), and a writer that inserts tracks, clips and locators.
- `crates/apricity-daw/src/ids.rs`: deterministic id allocation (same timeline → same ids), updating the set-wide next-pointee counter.
- gzip with a fixed header (no timestamp, no file name) so repeated exports are byte-identical.
- Tempo, time signature (`Timeline.tempo`, `Timeline.meter` over 4), loop brace over `Timeline.length_beats`, looping on.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw` — the tempo/time signature/loop brace/determinism scenarios of `features/daw/set.feature` pass; unit tests for the id allocator.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): DAW set skeleton, ids and deterministic gzip`. Not breaking.
